question.worked_solution:
To evaluate ${9}^{3},$ we start by writing it out with multiplication signs:

$$
{9}^{3}={{9\times 9\times 9}_{⏟}}_{3\text{ times}}
$$

Now, we compute the product. Since $9\times 9=81,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{{9\times 9}_{⏟}}_{81}\times 9 & =81\times 9.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we work out $81\times 9.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\,{}_{}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\,\end{aligned} \\  & \end{aligned}
$$

Since $81\times 9=729,$ we have ${9}^{3}=729.$
